params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

overloads.semanticRole: Sets or dynamically modifies, for the current process, the help tip shown when the cursor hovers over the object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: Passing an empty string "" removes the current help tip.
If a help tip is already displayed when this command is called, it is closed and a new tip is opened at the mouse location, restarting the Tips duration counter.
Can be used with a list box object to give a different help tip per row/cell (e.g. combined with LISTBOX GET CELL POSITION to determine the cursor's row).
Tips delay/duration are controlled globally via SET DATABASE PARAMETER, which can also disable help tips entirely.
